title: Filtered notification read-all acknowledgement

behavior.categoryAction: All categories keeps the existing workspace-scoped read-all action; a selected category sends the existing category query and labels the action with that category.
behavior.refresh: The selected feed is refreshed after acknowledgement and the existing summary endpoint remains the source of the unread badge.
behavior.preserved: Tenant/role guards, muted-category behavior, read/unread toggles, pagination, preferences, SSE reconnect, polling fallback, focus containment, scroll isolation and tenant-safe deep links remain unchanged.

localVerification.focusedBrowser: 4/4 notifications.spec.ts using owned Redis 6380 and existing Chrome

limits: This increment changes only category-scoped in-app acknowledgement wiring and browser regression coverage.
CI verifies owned fixtures and does not deploy.
Production/live-provider, external delivery, remote durability/RPO-RTO, deployed and full-master acceptance remain open.
